articles.title: Crypto PACs go undefeated in June primaries as Fairshake scores bipartisan winning streak
articles.snippet: Winners included Democrats Zoe Lofgren, Ted Lieu, Dave Min and Rob Menendez, as well as Republican Sen. Mike Rounds, with Democrats accounting for 10 of the 11 victories.

articles.title: Russian ruble stablecoin A7A5 grows despite Western sanctions: CertiK
articles.snippet: Russian ruble-backed stablecoin A7A5 processed over $110 billion in transactions despite Western sanctions, according to CertiK.

articles.title: UK regulator warns Premier League clubs over unauthorized crypto sponsors
articles.snippet: The FCA has urged clubs to rethink deals with unauthorized crypto and trading sponsors, warning that fans risk losing all their money and teams face legal and reputational fallout.

articles.title: Zcash Completes 'Most Ambitious' Network Upgrade as ZEC Resumes Recent Surge
articles.snippet: A Zcash vulnerability could have allowed double-spending within the network's flagship privacy pool, though no exploitation occurred.

articles.title: George Santos Referred to DOJ, CFTC Over State of the Union Kalshi Trades: Report
articles.snippet: The pardoned ex-congressman allegedly bet against his own State of the Union appearance while publicly hyping it.
